purpose: The SlicerVolBrain extension calculates volumes and provides 3D visualization and export tools for brain structures, tissues, lobes, and macrostructures segmented using volBrain.
summary: The SlicerVolBrain extension is well-structured, implements clear UI and logic for volumetric quantification and 3D visualization of volBrain NIfTI segmentations, includes a valid MIT license, and presents no safety or environmental concerns.

safety.rationale: No malicious code, network transmission without consent, or unsafe execution patterns found.

environment.rationale: No modifications to global environment or prohibited package installations.

packaging.rationale: CMake files properly install the scripted module.

soundness.rationale: Follows ScriptedLoadableModule conventions, though cleanup method is empty.

findings.title: Module cleanup method is empty
findings.explanation: The widget overrides cleanup() but does not remove VTK/MRML observers or clean up dynamically added nodes/scenes when the module is exited or reloaded, which can lead to memory leaks or dangling scene observers.
findings.suggestion: Implement proper cleanup of observers and temporary UI/scene resources in the cleanup method.

not_checked: Deep runtime execution of VolBrain processing on actual volBrain NIfTI outputs without a live Slicer session
